# @trysac/openapi-style-lint

> Style lint for OpenAPI 3.0 and 3.1 JSON documents with ten rules, RFC 6901 pointers, safe idempotent autofixes and a CLI TypeScript library for Node.js 20+, published as ES modules with type declarations. MIT.

## Docs

- [README](README.md): problem, installation and usage example
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): commands, folder map, conventions and limits for contributors and agents
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): modules and boundaries
- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how tests and coverage work
- [Decisions](docs/decisions/0001-record-architecture-decisions.md): architecture decision records

## Optional

- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
- [Project record](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope, timeline and effort metrics
